note: Set A binds the level markers correctly as elevations (solar envelope 18'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", grade 0'-0") and captures facts B omits, notably the 40-tube count from "2 X APSE-20 (40 TUBES)" and both General Sheet Note 3 items on door swing/tilt-and-turn operation. Set B adds the PV solar array and cable-railing material, but it re-labels the solar-envelope datum as a "height," invents a roof/upper-structure binding for the PV array, and asserts P1 is cement fibre board siding with a quote ("P1 CEMENT FIBRE BOARD SIDING") that does not appear in the source. Both sets are padded with near-duplicate handrail, cladding and finished-floor entries, so A's advantage rests on accuracy rather than coverage. A's only soft spot is the added condition "relative to Grade Level" on the finished-floor elevation, which is inferable from the drawing but not stated in its quote.
